business_summary: Asia Pile Holdings Corporation, through its subsidiaries, engages in the foundation construction business in Japan and Vietnam. It is also involved in the manufacturing and construction of concrete piles, as well as steel pipe piles and cast-in-place piles. The company was formerly known as Japan Pile Corporation and changed its name to Asia Pile Holdings Corporation in October 2015. Asia Pile Holdings Corporation was founded in 1923 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Asia Pile Holdings Corporation은 자회사를 통해 일본과 베트남에서 기초공사 사업을 영위하고 있습니다. 또한 콘크리트말뚝, 강관말뚝, 현장타설말뚝 등의 제조 및 시공도 하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Japan Pile Corporation으로 알려졌으며 2015년 10월에 Asia Pile Holdings Corporation으로 이름을 변경했습니다. Asia Pile Holdings Corporation은 1923년에 설립되었으며 일본 도쿄에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
